name: Zunyi, Guizhou
tagline: Home of Moutai & Red Cliff Wonders
intro: Famous for the town that distils the world's most prized baijiu (Moutai) and for the crimson sandstone peaks of Chishui Danxia, Zunyi pairs a rich revolutionary history with dramatic natural scenery. A refined, relaxed base for treatment and touring.

highlights.name: Moutai Town (茅台镇)
highlights.description: The birthplace of China's iconic spirit — riverside distilleries, aroma in the air, and a fascinating liquor culture museum.

highlights.name: Chishui Danxia (赤水丹霞)
highlights.description: UNESCO-listed red sandstone landforms, waterfalls and primeval forest — a photographer's dream.

highlights.name: Wujiangzhai (乌江寨)
highlights.description: A restored riverside village of lit bridges, paddle boats and evening performances — serene and romantic.

highlights.name: Revolutionary History Sites
highlights.description: Zunyi Meeting Site and related memorials tell a pivotal chapter of modern China.

itinerary.title: Wujiangzhai Village
itinerary.description: Half-day at the scenic riverside village.

itinerary.title: Chishui Danxia
itinerary.description: Red-rock waterfalls and forest — easy trails.

medical.advantages: Three clinics serve Zunyi and Renhuai, delivering the group's standard of care with the bonus of a slower, more affordable city. Ideal for travellers combining treatment with the Maotai trail — Zunyi is roughly two hours from the distillery, and Renhuai is the home of Maotai town itself.
